mapping_decision: Do NOT load Geoportal map/application entries into iris_staging.signal_ingest. A mapped substation or capacity does not establish a new legal approval. UVP-Verbund is an external approval-publications application listed by Geoportal; retain separate source provenance when harvesting approvals there.
limitations: Only the Geoportal applications catalogue and named substation article are checked.
No direct HTML approval-notice listing on geoportal.saarland.de has been verified.
The portal map viewer and potential WMS/WFS layer content are not harvested here.
